twoLiner: Modern, object-oriented language developed by Microsoft for cloud-native APIs with zero-allocation memory primitives (Span<T>).
detailed: C# combines high developer productivity with C++ level performance through RyuJIT, Generational Garbage Collection, and ref struct memory management. Ideal for high-throughput microservices.

twoLiner: Framework for building high-throughput RESTful services with built-in dependency injection, middleware pipelines, and OpenAPI support.
detailed: Acts as the backbone for modern distributed microservices. Features Kestrel web server, async request processing, and flexible middleware pipelines for authentication and logging.

twoLiner: Microsoft's ORM that allows developers to interact with databases using strongly typed C# LINQ queries instead of raw SQL.
detailed: Provides automated schema migrations, change tracking, and support for SQL Server and PostgreSQL. Can be tuned with AsNoTracking and Split Queries for high-throughput reads.

twoLiner: High-performance, contract-first RPC framework developed by Google running over HTTP/2 using binary Protocol Buffers.
detailed: Replaces JSON over HTTP/1.1 for low-latency synchronous microservice-to-microservice communication, offering 7-10x faster serialization and multiplexed streaming.

twoLiner: Real-time communication framework enabling servers to push live updates directly to connected web and mobile clients.
detailed: Eliminates polling overhead by establishing bidirectional WebSockets with fallbacks (SSE, Long Polling). Ideal for live telemetry, dashboards, and notifications.

twoLiner: Architectural style decomposing applications into small, autonomous, independently deployable services around business domains.
detailed: Enables independent scaling, fault isolation, and agile deployments. Requires eventual consistency, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry), and resilient API gateways.

twoLiner: Software design approach structuring systems around business domains using Ubiquitous Language, Aggregates, and Bounded Contexts.
detailed: Protects business rules from database or UI infrastructure concerns. Aggregate roots enforce consistency boundaries and emit domain events to other bounded contexts.

twoLiner: Pattern separating data modification operations (Commands) from data retrieval operations (Queries) into distinct models.
detailed: Allows independent optimization of read and write pipelines. Write side focuses on business invariants while read side uses optimized views, caches, and read replicas.

twoLiner: Distributed transaction pattern coordinating local transactions across microservices using compensating rollbacks.
detailed: Replaces blocking 2-Phase Commit (2PC). Can be implemented via Orchestration (central coordinator) or Choreography (event-driven) to guarantee eventual consistency across microservice databases.

twoLiner: Pattern preventing dual-write failures by saving business changes and outbound events in the same local database transaction.
detailed: A background publisher polls or listens via CDC (Change Data Capture) to dispatch events to message brokers (SQS/Kafka) reliably with at-least-once delivery guarantees.

twoLiner: Docker packages apps into immutable containers; Kubernetes automates scheduling, scaling, and zero-downtime rolling updates.
detailed: Guarantees environment parity from development to cloud. Kubernetes handles load balancing, self-healing, Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA), and configuration management.

twoLiner: Declarative IaC tool used to provision, version, and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure using code.
detailed: Maintains remote state locking (S3/DynamoDB) to prevent configuration drift. Integrates into CI/CD pipelines for automated multi-environment infrastructure deployments.

twoLiner: OAuth 2.0 provides delegated API authorization; OIDC adds user authentication and Single Sign-On (SSO) via signed ID tokens.
detailed: Industry-standard identity framework using Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, JWT tokens, and JWKS public key verification to protect enterprise APIs without exposing user credentials.

term: SQL Server Execution Plans & Index Tuning
twoLiner: Execution plans analyze physical query operations; index tuning converts expensive table scans into efficient direct index seeks.
detailed: Utilizes Clustered, Non-Clustered, and Covering (INCLUDE) indexes to eliminate Key Lookups and optimize high-concurrency enterprise queries under heavy load.

twoLiner: Signals provide fine-grained reactive state tracking; NgRx manages global immutable application state using Redux patterns.
detailed: Signals trigger surgical DOM updates without requiring Zone.js dirty checking across the component tree. NgRx provides predictable state machines for complex multi-tab enterprise portals.

twoLiner: React's asynchronous reconciliation engine that models the UI hierarchy as an interruptible singly linked-list tree of Fiber nodes.
detailed: Separates render diffing from synchronous DOM commit phases. Enables React 18 Concurrent Mode, prioritizing user interactions and preventing UI thread frame drops.

twoLiner: AI architecture that grounds LLMs in enterprise knowledge by retrieving relevant embeddings from a vector database at query time.
detailed: Eliminates LLM hallucinations and provides verifiable, source-attributed responses from private company documentation without requiring costly model fine-tuning.

twoLiner: Open-source SDK enabling .NET developers to orchestrate LLM prompts, memory connectors, and native C# plugins.
detailed: Bridges enterprise backend applications with Azure OpenAI. Allows C# functions to be exposed as native tools that LLM agents can autonomously invoke.
